name: @openclaw/webex-auto-join
description: Standalone Webex space meeting discovery and automatic join plugin for OpenClaw

scripts.build: esbuild src/service.ts --platform=node --format=cjs --bundle --outfile=dist/service.cjs && esbuild src/webex.ts --platform=node --format=cjs --bundle --outfile=dist/webex.cjs && esbuild src/audio-bridge.ts --platform=node --format=cjs --bundle --outfile=dist/audio-bridge.cjs && esbuild src/index.ts --platform=node --format=esm --bundle --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import{createRequire as __createRequire}from'node:module';const require=__createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/runner.ts --platform=browser --format=iife --bundle --outfile=dist/runner.js && node scripts/copy-webex-sdk.mjs
